statuses.Complete: Implemented and verified within the exact stated scope, with evidence. Local completion is not production release or whole-feature acceptance.
statuses.Partial: A verified portion exists; named remaining work prevents completion.
statuses.In progress: Actively being worked on, not a claim of continuous background activity.
statuses.Not started: Recorded and pending implementation or specification; approved direction is not delivery.
statuses.Blocked: A named prerequisite prevents this scoped item; independent safe actions should continue.

rules: Keep stable IDs. Append new actions; never renumber or drop comments.

Update evidence, remaining work and change history with each implementation increment. Preserve earlier failures.
Meaningful updates use the same action table, Dubai date/time, checks and next concrete IDs. Unchanged automated runs stay quiet.
Do not use a numerical completion percentage: rows differ greatly in effort and product significance.
